statement: Sysco Corporation's case volumes increased 3.1% in fiscal 2024 compared to fiscal 2023.
The case volume increase in Sysco's U.S. Foodservice Operations was driven by higher inflation and volume growth, including benefits from acquisitions in fiscal 2024.

Vistra Corp.'s Sunset segment includes generation plants with announced retirement dates after December 31, 2024, and unrealized gains and losses on commodity risk management activities are allocated to this segment.
Vistra Corp. separately reports the Sunset segment to differentiate operating plants with retirement plans from those in other segments.
Paychex, Inc.'s PEO insurance costs increased 13% in fiscal 2024 compared to fiscal 2023.
News Corporation's Foxtel segment generated strong cash flow due to monetization of long-term sports rights across multiple platforms.
Moody's Corporation's Decision Solutions (DS) revenue increased 9% in the six months ended June 30, 2024, compared to the same period in 2023.
Moody's Corporation's Research and Insights (R&I) revenue increased 4% in the six months ended June 30, 2024, compared to the same period in 2023.
Moody's Corporation's Data and Information (D&I) revenue increased 10% in the six months ended June 30, 2024, compared to the same period in 2023.
Moody's Corporation's total external revenue increased 8% in the six months ended June 30, 2024, compared to the same period in 2023.
Moody's Corporation's total MA revenue increased 8% in the six months ended June 30, 2024, compared to the same period in 2023.
Moody's Analytics revenue grew 7% or 8% on a constant-currency basis, as noted in the remarks.

Domino's Pizza, Inc. reported a $5.0 million increase in supply chain gross margin in the first quarter of 2025, representing a 6.9% increase in absolute terms and a 0.5 percentage point increase as a percentage of supply chain revenues.
Texas Instruments Incorporated's Analog segment revenue increased 13% in Q1 2025 compared with Q1 2024.
Texas Instruments Incorporated's Analog segment operating profit increased 20% in Q1 2025 compared with Q1 2024.
Arthur J. Gallagher & Co. used operating cash to fund the $100.0 million Series HH note maturity with a fixed rate of 4.72% due February 13, 2024, during February 2024.
Arthur J. Gallagher & Co. used operating cash to fund the $325.0 million Series H note maturity with a fixed rate of 4.58% due February 27, 2024, during February 2024.
The AES Corporation is a global energy company focusing on renewable energy solutions, particularly for data centers in the U.S. and mining companies outside the U.S.
AES has a backlog of 11.9 GW of renewable energy projects, including 4.4 GW of long-term contracts signed in 2024.
Huntington Ingalls Industries, Inc.'s total backlog was $48.0 billion as of March 31, 2025, and $48.7 billion as of December 31, 2024.
The increase in backlog was primarily due to new contract awards of approximately $2.1 billion during the three months ended March 31, 2025.
Visa Inc.'s total payments volume growth was 8% in the three months ended September 30, 2024, compared to the same period in 2023.
Consumer credit growth contributed 5% to Visa Inc.'s payments volume growth in the three months ended September 30, 2024.
Consumer debit growth was 11% in the three months ended September 30, 2024, compared to the same period in 2023.
Commercial growth contributed 6% to Visa Inc.'s payments volume growth in the three months ended September 30, 2024.

NextEra Energy Resources' investment in XPLR was written down to its estimated fair value of $1.0 billion due to an OTTI impairment, resulting in an impairment charge of $0.7 billion ($0.5 billion after tax).
The OTTI impairment of XPLR was based on the fair value analysis using the market approach and the observable trading price of XPLR's common units at $9.50 per unit as of March 31, 2025.
Globe Life Inc. has an ongoing share repurchase program that began in 1986 and continues indefinitely unless modified by the Board of Directors.
The company's share repurchases are funded by excess cash flow, defined as dividends received from subsidiaries less interest paid on debt.
Huntington Ingalls Industries, Inc. paid cash dividends of $1.30 per share or $52 million in aggregate during the quarter.
Nasdaq, Inc.'s compensation and benefits expense increased 28.7% in the third quarter of 2024 compared with the same period in 2023.
Nasdaq, Inc.'s compensation and benefits expense increased 28.7% in the first nine months of 2024 compared with the same period in 2023.
Lennox International Inc. divested its European operations in the fourth quarter of 2023.
Equity Residential's Residential operations accounted for approximately 96.2% of total revenues for the six months ended June 30, 2024.
Equity Residential maintained occupancy rates at or above 95% in its expansion markets despite the impact of new supply.
Biogen Inc.'s MS product revenue decreased 11% year-over-year in FY2025 Q1 compared to FY2024 Q1.
The decline in MS revenue was driven primarily by increased competition, including biosimilar entrants and pricing reductions.
Labcorp Holdings Inc.'s Dx revenues increased 7.9% in FY2024 Q2 compared to the same period in 2023, reaching $2,524.9 million.
The Dx revenue growth was driven by organic revenue of 4.7% and acquisitions, net of divestitures, of 3.2%, partially offset by unfavorable foreign currency translation of 0.1% in FY2024 Q2.

Regeneron Pharmaceuticals' share of profits from the Bayer collaboration increased 26% in the three months ended September 30, 2024, compared to the same period in 2023, driven by volume growth for Dupixent and improving collaboration margins.
Regeneron Pharmaceuticals' share of profits from the Bayer collaboration reached $367.6 million in the three months ended September 30, 2024, an all-time high.
Lockheed Martin Corporation’s Aeronautics business segment reported net sales of $28,618 million in FY2024, an increase of $1.1 billion or 4% compared to FY2023.

The increase in Aeronautics’ net sales was primarily due to higher sales on the F-35 program ($1.0 billion) and the F-16 program ($210 million), partially offset by a $200 million decrease on classified programs.
Zoetis Inc.'s cost of sales as a percentage of revenue increased from 28.6% in the six months ended June 30, 2023, to 28.8% in the six months ended June 30, 2024.

The increase in cost of sales was primarily due to unfavorable manufacturing and other costs and unfavorable foreign exchange, partially offset by price increases, favorable product mix, lower freight costs, and lower inventory charges.
Solventum Corporation's Health Information Systems segment sales increased 1.5% in the third quarter of 2024 compared to the same period in 2023.

The 1.5% sales growth in Health Information Systems was driven by continued adoption of 3M TM 360 Encompass TM, partially offset by declines in clinician productivity solutions due to changing market conditions.
CME Group Inc. recorded a daily volume record of 34.4 million contracts for US Treasuries on May 28th during FY2024 Q2.

Delta Air Lines, Inc. experienced a significant technology-related operational disruption in July 2024 due to a faulty CrowdStrike software update, resulting in flight delays and approximately 7,000 flight cancellations over five days.

Gilead Sciences, Inc. assumed a liability related to future royalties from its acquisition of Immunomedics, based on net sales of Trodelvy under a funding agreement with RPI Finance Trust through approximately 2036.
The liability for future royalties is amortized over 16 years using the effective interest rate method, with interest expense recognized prospectively.
Walmart Inc.'s Walmart U.S. segment's eCommerce sales contributed approximately 2.5% to comparable sales for the three months ended July 31, 2023.
Walmart Inc.'s Sam's Club segment's eCommerce sales contributed approximately 1.8% to comparable sales for the three months ended July 31, 2023.
NRG Energy, Inc. is subject to regulatory proceedings and market rules in the ISO and RTO markets where it operates, which may impact its wholesale and retail operations.

NRG and its subsidiaries are involved in other regulatory proceedings arising in the ordinary course of business, but management believes these will not materially adversely affect consolidated financials.
IQVIA Holdings Inc.'s Research & Development Solutions segment had a contracted backlog of $31.5 billion as of March 31, 2025, up from $31.1 billion as of December 31, 2024.
Research & Development Solutions reported revenues of $2,102 million for the first quarter of 2025, an increase of $7 million or 0.3% compared to the same period in 2024.

The revenue increase for Research & Development Solutions in Q1 2025 was driven by constant currency revenue growth of approximately $23 million or 1.1%, primarily from volume-related increases in clinical services in the Asia-Pacific and Europe and Africa regions.
The constant currency revenue growth for Research & Development Solutions in Q1 2025 was impacted by a decrease in COVID-19 related work.
Research & Development Solutions' cost of revenues, exclusive of depreciation and amortization, increased $31 million or 2.2% in Q1 2025 compared to Q1 2024.

The cost of revenues increase for Research & Development Solutions in Q1 2025 was primarily due to a constant currency increase of approximately $63 million or 4.5%, mainly from higher compensation and related expenses linked to volume growth in clinical services.
The AES Corporation allocated $300 million and $50 million of the proceeds from a $350 million credit agreement to AES Hispanola Holdings BV and Colon, respectively, in January 2023.
AES Indiana issued $650 million aggregate principal of 5.70% First Mortgage Bonds due April 2054 in March 2024, using net proceeds to repay existing indebtedness and for general corporate purposes.

AES Clean Energy Development, AES Renewable Holdings, and sPower executed a financing agreement for up to $2.4 billion in December 2023, with $1.3 billion in outstanding borrowings as of June 30, 2024, used to repay existing indebtedness and fund renewables projects.

Bristol Myers Squibb Co announced EC approval of Breyanzi for the treatment of adult patients with relapsed or refractory follicular lymphoma (FL) after two or more lines of systemic therapy in March 2025.

The Breyanzi approval is based on results from the global, Phase II TRANSCEND FL study, which met its primary endpoint of overall response rate in the MZL cohort and the key secondary endpoint of complete response rate.
Viatris Inc. excluded purchase accounting impacts from adjusted EBITDA, adjusted net earnings, and adjusted EPS for acquisitions accounted for under ASC 805, regardless of financing method.

Viatris Inc. excluded changes in fair value of assets and liabilities, including contingent consideration, from adjusted EBITDA, adjusted net earnings, and adjusted EPS due to variability and lack of predictability.
Viatris Inc. excluded share-based compensation expense from adjusted cost of sales, adjusted EBITDA, adjusted net earnings, and adjusted EPS.
Viatris Inc. excluded restructuring, acquisition, and divestiture-related costs from adjusted cost of sales, adjusted EBITDA, adjusted net earnings, and adjusted EPS.
Oracle Corporation's hardware support contracts are generally priced as a percentage of net hardware products fees and recognized as revenues ratably over contractual terms.
Oracle's hardware business has lower operating margins as a percentage of revenues compared to cloud and license businesses due to incremental production and distribution costs.
Teledyne Technologies Incorporated's industrial automation and electronic test and measurement markets experienced no full year sales growth in FY2024 Q3 compared to the prior year.
Sales in Teledyne's industrial automation and electronic test and measurement markets weakened more than planned in the first half of FY2024 but have stabilized or begun to recover sequentially.
LyondellBasell Industries N.V. increased its senior unsecured revolving credit facility to $3,750 million in July 2024, extending the maturity to July 2029.
As of September 30, 2024, LyondellBasell Industries N.V. had $3,750 million of unused availability under its Senior Revolving Credit Facility.
The Procter & Gamble Company measures market share as the percentage of sales of its products in dollar terms on a constant currency basis relative to all product sales in the category.

The Company measures quarter and fiscal year to date market shares through the most recent period for which market share data is available, which typically reflects a lag time of one or two months as compared to the end of the reporting period.
Apple Inc.'s iPhone net sales decreased 10% in the March quarter of 2024 compared to the same period in 2023.
Apple Inc.'s iPhone net sales were relatively flat during the first six months of 2024 compared to the same period in 2023.
Paycom Software, Inc.'s effective income tax rate was 23% for the year ended December 31, 2024.
The 2024 effective income tax rate of 23% reflects a decrease from 28% in 2023, primarily due to factors including a research credit benefit of 1% and stock-based compensation impact of 4%.
AvalonBay Communities, Inc. completed the migration to a new human resource and payroll solution during the second quarter of 2024 as part of its ERP system implementation.
Mohawk Industries, Inc.'s Flooring North America segment had sales of just over $930 million in FY2024.
Zebra Technologies Corporation's AIT segment reported a 17.9% increase in Net sales for FY2025 Q1 compared to FY2024 Q1.
The AIT segment's Organic Net sales growth was 18.4% for FY2025 Q1, excluding foreign currency impacts.
Foreign currency translation had a 0.5% negative impact on AIT's reported Net sales growth in FY2025 Q1.
Motorola Solutions, Inc.'s Operating earnings increased $246 million, or 27%, in the first half of 2024 compared to the first half of 2023.

The increase in Operating earnings was primarily driven by a $301 million increase in the Products and Systems Integration segment, due to higher sales, favorable mix, and reduced intangible asset amortization, partially offset by higher employee incentive costs and expenses from acquired businesses.

The increase in Operating earnings was partially offset by a $55 million decrease in the Software and Services segment, driven by reduced Airwave services revenue and higher employee incentive costs, partially offset by lower intangible amortization expenses.
